name: Mental Supremacy, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 9, druid 9, psychic 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions like mental supremacy, except that it affects multiple creatures.
